basics.name: WangZe Zhang
basics.label: Software Engineering Student
basics.summary: Software Engineering undergraduate student at Nanjing University with experience in backend development, cloud-native environments, and project management.

projects.name: Intelligent Document Reading Assistant Platform
projects.description: A platform for researchers to read and analyze PDF papers with features including PDF annotation, LLM summarization, LLM dialogue, translation, and cloud notes.
highlights: Designed backend architecture based on Spring MVC structure for a front-end/back-end separated project
Implemented PDF file processing including paginated uploading and Redis caching for PDF processing results
Developed LLM-related features (summarization and conversation) including GPT-4o API integration and session persistence/caching
Implemented multi-threaded PDF page processing, reducing processing time to approximately 1/6 of the original single-threaded approach
Added asynchronous processing for GPT-4o API calls to reduce loading time for users

projects.name: Online Music Platform
projects.description: A deployable and maintainable online music platform with microservice architecture.
highlights: Configured cloud-native environment including CI/CD pipeline design and construction, Nacos integration, and cloud server configuration for final deployment
Built infrastructure microservices, primarily focusing on gateway and middleware components
Implemented high availability features including rate limiting and circuit breaking mechanisms based on Istio Gateway, with simple load balancing
Used cluster mirror queue technology for middleware
Developed cloud-native development and deployment process using Nacos for microservice management, GitLab for CI/CD pipeline configuration, and Kubernetes for deployment

intern.summary: Worked on the Fiber Optic Cable Mapping System development.
highlights: Developed rendering of maintenance status for individual fiber optic cables, daily maintenance records and defect analysis with persistence.
Implemented maintenance personnel inspection ticket and defect form data parsing.
Optimized performance for database queries related to fiber optic cable information tables.
